limitations: The Lean and Quint artefacts are references for the norn.core pack laws, not refinement proofs of the Rust kernel.
Inheritance holds only for value moved through types that declare an accounting leg; other writes are boundaries where the claim stops.
Commitment completion has no runtime enforcement yet; the cell deadline timer is assumed to raise the deadline event for every open commitment.
The quantity and escrow references model one resource and one balance partition; multi-partition behaviour is tested in the cell, not proved.
Stock valuation and Commitment/Claim disjointness are specified only; the checker does not yet refuse a type implementing both primitives.
Quantity conservation is covered per resource only; coupling a transformation's outputs to its consumed inputs is not modelled, tested or proved.
